description: Open-source aerial and flood footage for offline Jetson benchmarks.

combined_rescue_recommendation.notes: Use COLOR clips for models trained on RGB flood imagery. B&W historical footage (Hollywood 1938) is poor for flood segmentation. Combined mode needs people + water in frame.

videos.name: Hollywood / LA-Long Beach floods 1938-39 — boats rescuing people (B&W only)
videos.license: Internet Archive / public domain historical footage
videos.notes: Not recommended — black & white; flood models trained on color RGB.

videos.name: Kherson drone water delivery to flood victims (DRSG, June 2023) ★ COLOR
videos.license: Editorial/news (Guardian mirror); Reddit source — local testing only
videos.highlight_frames: flood_ratio 0.8+ on submerged-house segments; humans often 0 (top-down, small targets)
videos.notes: Same event as r/ukraine post. File: benchmarks/videos/kherson_drone_rescue.mp4

videos.name: Children rescued from Chittur river flood — Kerala, India (MediaOne TV) ★ COLOR
videos.highlight_frames: frame ~3700: up to 10 humans; flood_ratio 0.27–0.64 across clip
videos.notes: Ground-level news footage (not drone). Strong combined-rescue benchmark. File: benchmarks/videos/chittur_river_rescue.mp4

videos.name: Cumbria flood rescues — Storm Desmond 2015 (YouTube CC BY) ★ COLOR
Flood Preparedness — Cal OES (YouTube CC BY)
videos.notes: Shorter CC clip; less dramatic than Cumbria/Hollywood rescue.

videos.name: Mississippi River Flood 1927 — evacuations (Internet Archive)
videos.notes: People + animals evacuated; 17 min, low resolution. Use --render-stride 3+.

videos.name: Aerial massive flooding at airfield (Internet Archive)
videos.license: Internet Archive item — verify item page
videos.archive_file: Aerial- Massive flooding hits Russian airfield.mp4
videos.notes: Great flood segmentation; no visible humans (human_count stays 0).

videos.name: 1955 California flood footage (Internet Archive, public domain)
videos.notes: ~16 min; river/highway damage; unlikely human detections.

videos.name: Drone flood city (Pexels)
videos.notes: May include street-level people; browser download (Pexels 403 on Jetson).

tradeoff_notes.altitude: Higher AGL → wider ground coverage per frame, coarser GSD.
tradeoff_notes.simulation: benchmark scales frame resolution by REF_ALTITUDE/altitude then letterboxes to 640x480.
tradeoff_notes.combined_rescue: Prefer ground-level or low-altitude clips with people in/near water; pure aerial top-down often yields human_count=0.
